description: An earlier hold no longer applies. Signed by the recorder and then by the person or service releasing it, whose key is not the recorder's, so that whoever holds the recorder's key alone cannot release a hold.

details.description: Issuer-defined detail: up to 64 named scalars. Nothing in it is interpreted by the base kinds, and nothing in it is content; content goes behind a reference.

hold.description: The identity of one signed evidence record.
